[[Duchess/Legends|Duchess]] '''Thax''' was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Humanoid/Legends|Humanoid]] [[Noble/Legends|noble]] who served the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]].

==Biography==
During the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], Thax was dispatched to the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Themis]] to negotiate with the world's leader, [[Prince/Legends|Prince]] [[Lumon]], for the supply of explosive [[Ore/Legends|ore]] from the [[Themis moon|moon of Themis]]. However, the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] and [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]] also arrived in order to persuade Lumon to supply the ore to the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] instead, but neither party was able to convince Lumon, who dismissed Thax and the Jedi.

In an attempt to discredit Kenobi, on the orders of the [[Duke/Legends|duchess]], Thax's [[Thax's agent|agent]] planted a [[Thax's sabotage droid|droid]] onto Kenobi's [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighter]], which sabotaged the craft and sent Kenobi and his vessel hurtling toward the explosive [[Moon/Legends|moon]]. The sabotage created the impression that Kenobi was deliberately trying to destroy the moon and Thax used that to persuade Lumon that the Jedi were fanatics who would willingly risk the lives of the prince's citizens for their cause. Kenobi's fighter was subsequently destroyed by Lumon's security forces, but the [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] survived and returned to Themis with a scrap of the droid that had sabotaged his vessel. When Kenobi confronted Lumon and Thax with evidence of Thax's deceit, the duchess held Lumon at [[Blaster/Legends|blasterpoint]] and threatened to [[Death/Legends|kill]] the prince if Kenobi tried to move toward her. However, Skywalker used his [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]] to disarm her, and Lumon subsequently expelled Thax and her Separatist delegation from the world.
